paper: A Multimodal Foundation Agent for Financial Trading: Tool-Augmented, Diversified, and Generalist
headline_mechanism: FinAgent fuses market-intelligence text and price-chart modalities, retrieves diversified memories, performs low-level price-movement and high-level decision reflection, consults trading tools, and emits Buy/Hold/Sell.

source_anchors.claim: Latest and retrieved market intelligence is summarized alongside Kline price charts over short, medium, and long horizons.
Separate query types retrieve the top K historical intelligence records from multiple perspectives.
Low-level reflection relates information and charts to price changes; high-level reflection reviews past decisions and subsequent outcomes.
The final decision combines intelligence, both reflections, trader preference, and augmented technical strategy tools.

preserved_elements: separate market-intelligence and price-chart modality scores
short, medium, and long horizon representations
three diversified retrieval queries with top-five memories each
high-level correction from prior decision outcomes
selection among augmented momentum, reversal, and breakout strategy tools
approximated_elements: JKP fundamental and attention characteristics replace news/report summaries
one-, three-, and six-month price signals replace 1-, 7-, and 14-day Kline images
numeric cosine retrieval replaces GPT-generated query embeddings
rolling ridge synthesis replaces multimodal low-level LLM reflection
a past decision-correctness memory vote replaces high-level natural-language reflection
invented_elements: the exact JKP modality feature bundles
past-only Sharpe selection among three technical tools
fixed reflection/tool mixing weights and common decile portfolio adapter
portfolio_adapter: The reflected multimodal confidence is ranked within the frozen monthly top-1,000 universe and mapped to common value-weighted long/short deciles with 10 bp one-way cost.
claim_boundary: This is a researcher-authored FinAgent-inspired numeric multimodal policy, not the released agent's missing FMP inputs, chart images, GPT-4/GPT-4V memories and reflections, actions, or native results.
